title: ClongCraft Modpack
description: A modpack for the ClongCraft server. Based on Fabulously Optimised.
body:
This is a modpack meant for the ClongCraft server. It includes several optimisation mods, and other quality of life mods.

Iris and shaders do not appear to be compatible with the ClongCraft banner resource packs :(
(based off Fabulously Optimised)

Contact fridayfaerie on Discord for help.
